templates.name: security_plan_starter
templates.description: Operational SSP planning workbook that connects system scope, control implementation, evidence, inheritance, and review ownership.

compatibility.claim: Planning aid aligned to NIST RMF concepts and the current FedRAMP Certification Package Overview and Security Decision Record transition path.
compatibility.limitations: Not an official SSP or FedRAMP package. The historical Rev5 SSP is legacy; select the applicable 2026 rules, class, path, and schemas before use.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2 and NIST OSCAL SSP model

templates.name: implementation_statement_worksheet
templates.description: Control-by-control drafting worksheet with ownership, evidence, inheritance, and eMASS API v3.22-aligned fields.

compatibility.claim: Uses public v3.22 control field names and enumerations as preparation guidance.
compatibility.limitations: Not an eMASS-generated import template and not directly importable. Instance-specific rules may differ.

provenance.basis: MITRE emass_client OpenAPI v3.22 Controls schemas

templates.name: evidence_expectation_matrix
templates.description: Evidence planning matrix with cross-references, ownership, collection cadence, freshness, confidence, and assessor-facing notes.

compatibility.claim: Evidence planning aid cross-referenced to ingested controls, CCIs, and STIG/SRG rules.
compatibility.limitations: Evidence examples are planning prompts, not assessor acceptance decisions.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 and ingested DISA cross-references

templates.name: stig_evidence_checklist
templates.description: Officially specified STIG Viewer CSV columns plus a separate evidence working-notes sheet for assessment preparation.

compatibility.claim: Primary table uses the 12 CSV headers documented by the DISA STIG Viewer 3.x User Guide V1R7.
compatibility.limitations: Control Atlas does not certify STIG Viewer import success; validate in the target STIG Viewer version.

provenance.basis: DISA STIG Viewer 3.x User Guide V1R7 CSV import contract

official_alternative.label: DISA STIG Viewer and SRG/STIG tools

templates.name: inheritance_worksheet
templates.description: Control inheritance decision log covering provider evidence, freshness, local responsibilities, deltas, and decision basis.

compatibility.claim: Supports responsibility analysis using NIST RMF and OSCAL inheritance concepts.
compatibility.limitations: Does not replace a provider CRM/CIS or authorize inherited-control acceptance.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2 and OSCAL implemented-requirement inheritance concepts

official_alternative.label: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules and current provider documentation

templates.name: reciprocity_checklist
templates.description: Structured package-reuse review with artifact freshness, ownership, gaps, risk decisions, and receiving-organization actions.

compatibility.claim: Organizes evidence needed for a receiving organization to evaluate authorization-package reuse.
compatibility.limitations: Does not grant reciprocity or substitute for the receiving Authorizing Official's decision.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2 authorization and ongoing-authorization concepts

templates.name: poam_starter
templates.description: Operational POA&M register with remediation, milestone, evidence, ownership, and eMASS API v3.22-aligned preparation fields.

compatibility.claim: Includes public eMASS v3.22 POA&M field names and separates general remediation tracking from current FedRAMP provider vulnerability reporting and agency-owned POA&Ms.
compatibility.limitations: Not an eMASS-generated or FedRAMP import template. For FedRAMP, determine whether the action belongs to the provider or agency before creating a POA&M entry.

provenance.basis: MITRE emass_client OpenAPI v3.22 POA&M schemas; historical layout lessons from Vulnerator

templates.name: assessment_planning_worksheet
templates.description: Control assessment schedule covering scope, assessor, methods, evidence, tooling, sampling, dates, results, and follow-up.

compatibility.claim: Uses eMASS v3.22 test-result concepts alongside NIST SP 800-53A assessment planning.
compatibility.limitations: Not a Security Assessment Plan or eMASS test-result import. Current FedRAMP rules do not require a separate SAP/SAR; route assessment summaries and results to the applicable package and Security Decision Record.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-53A Rev. 5 and MITRE emass_client v3.22 Test Results schema

templates.name: conmon_calendar
templates.description: Monitoring schedule that connects activities to deliverables, evidence locations, owners, completion, reporting, and escalation.

compatibility.claim: Starter operating calendar aligned to NIST monitoring concepts and current FedRAMP OCR and vulnerability-reporting artifacts.
compatibility.limitations: Cadences are planning defaults. Current FedRAMP rule-specific effective dates, certification profile, authorization conditions, and contracts take precedence.

provenance.basis: NIST SP 800-137 and NIST SP 800-37 Rev. 2

templates.name: hardware_baseline
templates.description: Asset inventory with operational ownership and eMASS API v3.22 hardware-baseline preparation fields.

compatibility.claim: Uses public v3.22 hardware-baseline field names with additional local inventory fields.
compatibility.limitations: Not an eMASS-generated import template and not directly importable.

provenance.basis: DCSA hardware list and MITRE emass_client OpenAPI v3.22 hardware schemas

templates.name: software_baseline
templates.description: Software inventory with lifecycle, approval, ownership, dependency, and eMASS API v3.22 preparation fields.

compatibility.claim: Uses public v3.22 software-baseline field names with additional local lifecycle fields.
compatibility.limitations: Not an eMASS-generated import template and not directly importable.

provenance.basis: DCSA software list and MITRE emass_client OpenAPI v3.22 software schemas

templates.name: ppsm_preparation_worksheet
templates.description: Local collection worksheet for ports, protocols, services, boundaries, mission need, exposure, and approval tracking before PPSM submission.

compatibility.claim: Prepares publicly documented PPSM information for review and later entry into the authorized registry workflow.
compatibility.limitations: Not an official PPSM worksheet, registry receipt, or import file.

provenance.basis: DoDI 8551.01 and public DISA PPSM training
